Description: Infection/transmission from infectious individuals to susceptible individuals within a city, proportional to contact rate and the fraction infectious.
Progression from exposed to infectious at rate epsilon.
Recovery or removal from the infectious state at rate r, representing self-isolation/effective removal and recovery.

Name: c
Description: Average number of daily contacts used in transmission.

Name: r
Description: Rate of recovery/removal from the infectious state.

Name: epsilon
Description: Rate of progression from exposed to infectious.

Name: R0
Description: Basic reproduction number used to calculate the daily contact rate.

Name: average infectious period
Description: Average time spent infectious, used to derive r.

Name: average time spent exposed but not infectious
Description: Average incubation period, used to derive epsilon.

Name: time from onset to first medical visit and isolation
Description: Used as a proxy for average infectious period under improved case identification and isolation.
